::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Week 7** | Original topics: Risk · Derivatives · Financial Regulation · The Foreign Exchange Market
:::

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

1. Distinguish between systematic and idiosyncratic risk and explain diversification
2. Describe the main types of derivatives and what purpose they serve
3. Explain why financial regulation exists and what forms it takes
4. Describe how exchange rates are determined and what drives them
5. Connect exchange rate dynamics to monetary policy and the broader macroeconomy
